SELECT code_module, assessment_type
FROM (
  SELECT a.code_module, a.assessment_type, 
         AVG(sa.score) AS avg_score,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.code_module ORDER BY AVG(sa.score) DESC) as rn
  FROM assessments a
  JOIN studentAssessment sa ON a.id_assessment = sa.id_assessment
  WHERE sa.score IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY a.code_module, a.assessment_type
)
WHERE rn = 1
